description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding an amount of {C} equal to Vhal's toughness that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Haunted One triggers, causing Humans and Wizards you control to get +2/+0 and to gain undying until end of turn.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sage of Hours.
When Sage of Hours dies, its undying ability and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Humans and Wizards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Sage of Hours' power.
Repeat.
